source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כִּסְאִ֔י וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י אֵי־זֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּבְנוּ־לִ֔י וְאֵי־זֶ֥ה מָק֖וֹם מְנוּחָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: The heavens [are] my throne, and the earth [is the] footstool of my feet. Where [is] this house that you will build for me, and where [is] this place of my rest?

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: The heavens [are] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} throne, \q and the earth [is] the footstool of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet. \q Where [is] this house that you would build for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q and where [is] this place of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest?
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: The heavens are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} throne, \q and the earth is a stool for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet. \q What kind of house would you build for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q and what kind of place could be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} resting place?
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Heaven is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} throne, \q and the earth is where I rest {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet. \q So what kind of house could you build for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? \q What kind of place could you make for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to rest in?

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Los cielos [son] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} trono, \q y la tierra [es] el estrado de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies. \q ¿Dónde [está] esa casa que {{plural_you:me edificarían|me edificaríais}}, \q y dónde [está] ese lugar de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo?
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Los cielos son {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} trono, \q y la tierra es un estrado para {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies. \q ¿Qué clase de casa {{plural_you:podrían edificarme|podríais edificarme}}, \q y qué clase de lugar podría ser {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar de reposo?
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: El cielo es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} trono, \q y la tierra es donde apoyo {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies. \q Entonces, ¿qué clase de casa {{plural_you:podrían construir|podríais construir}} para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}? \q ¿Qué clase de lugar {{plural_you:podrían|podríais}} hacer para que yo descanse?

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Les cieux [sont] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trône, \q et la terre [est] le marchepied de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds. \q Où [est] cette maison que vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} bâtiriez, \q et où [est] ce lieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos ?
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Le ciel est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trône, \q et la terre un escabeau pour {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds. \q Quelle maison pourriez-vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} bâtir, \q et quel lieu pourrait être celui de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos ?
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Le ciel est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trône, \q et la terre est l’endroit où je pose {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds. \q Alors quelle maison pourriez-vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} construire ? \q Quel endroit pourriez-vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} préparer pour que je m’y repose ?

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Mbingu [ni] kiti {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} cha enzi, \q na dunia [ni] kibao cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Iko wapi nyumba hii ambayo mngenijengea, \q na pako wapi mahali hapa pa pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}?
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Mbingu ni kiti {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} cha enzi, \q na dunia ni kiti cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Ni nyumba ya namna gani mngeweza kunijengea, \q na ni mahali pa namna gani pangekuwa pa pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}?
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Mbingu ni kiti {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} cha enzi, \q na dunia ni mahali ninapoweka miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Basi ni nyumba ya namna gani mnayoweza kunijengea? \q Ni mahali pa namna gani mnayoweza kunitengenezea ili nipumzike?

decisions.choice: heaven as God's throne and the earth as his footstool: no building can contain him
decisions.reason: Solomon said at the dedication of the temple that heaven itself cannot contain God, much less a house (1 Kings 8:27). Stephen quotes this verse and the next in Acts 7:49-50, and Jesus speaks of heaven as God's throne and the earth as his footstool in Matthew 5:34-35.

decisions.choice: where is this house: what sort of house could be fit for me
decisions.reason: The question can ask where the house is or what kind of house it would be. Either way it expects no answer: nothing people build can be a fitting home for the Maker of heaven and earth (2 Samuel 7:5-7).

decisions.choice: the place of my rest: the temple, God's dwelling among his people
decisions.reason: The temple is called God's resting place in Psalm 132:8, 14 and 1 Chronicles 28:2, where the ark is the footstool of God's feet. The verse does not reject the temple (verse 6; 56:7) but rejects the idea that God needs it.

decisions.choice: where I rest my feet
decisions.reason: Readable explains "footstool" by saying what a footstool is for.

decisions.choice: kiti changu cha enzi; kiti (kibao) cha kuwekea miguu yangu
decisions.reason: Acts 7:49 quotes the line, with "kiti changu cha enzi" and "kiti cha kuwekea miguu yangu"; Balanced keeps those words, and Literal names the footstool "kibao".

source.text: וְאֶת־כָּל־אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָדִ֣י עָשָׂ֔תָה וַיִּהְי֥וּ כָל־אֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶל־זֶ֣ה אַבִּ֔יט אֶל־עָנִי֙ וּנְכֵה־ר֔וּחַ וְחָרֵ֖ד עַל־דְּבָרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And all these [things] my hand made, and all these [things] came to be, declares Yahweh; and to this [one] I will look: to [the] afflicted and stricken of spirit, and trembling at my word.

en.L: And all these [things] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand made, \q and all these [things] came into being, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q But to this [one] I will look: \q to [the] afflicted and stricken in spirit, \q and trembling at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} word.
en.B: My own hand made all these things, \q and that is how they all exist, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q The one I will regard with favor is the lowly, the broken in spirit, \q who trembles at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} word.
en.R: I made all these things myself, \q and that is why they exist, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I am pleased with people who are humble and whose spirit is broken, \q people who tremble with awe at what I say.

es.L: Y todas estas [cosas] hizo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano, \q y así todas estas [cosas] llegaron a ser, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Pero a este miraré: \q al afligido y quebrantado de espíritu, \q y que tiembla ante {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} palabra.
es.B: Mi propia mano hizo todas estas cosas, \q y por eso existen todas, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Aquel a quien miraré con favor es el humilde, el quebrantado de espíritu, \q que tiembla ante {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} palabra.
es.R: Yo mismo hice todas estas cosas, \q y por eso existen, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Estoy contento con la gente que es humilde y tiene el espíritu quebrantado, \q la gente que tiembla con reverencia ante lo que digo.

fr.L: Et toutes ces [choses], {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main les a faites, \q et toutes ces [choses] sont venues à l’existence, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Mais voici celui que je regarderai : \q l’affligé, celui qui a l’esprit abattu, \q et qui tremble à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} parole.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main qui a fait tout cela, \q et c’est ainsi que tout existe, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Celui que je regarde avec faveur, c’est l’humble, celui qui a l’esprit brisé \q et qui tremble à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} parole.
fr.R: J’ai fait toutes ces choses {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, \q et c’est pour cela qu’elles existent, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je regarde avec bonté les gens humbles, ceux dont l’esprit est brisé, \q ceux qui tremblent avec respect devant ce que je dis.

sw.L: Na vitu hivi vyote mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ulivifanya, \q na vitu hivi vyote vikawepo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Lakini huyu ndiye nitakayemwangalia: \q aliyeteswa na mwenye roho iliyopondeka, \q na anayetetemeka kwa neno {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: Mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe ulifanya vitu hivi vyote, \q na ndivyo vyote vilivyokuja kuwepo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Ninayemwangalia kwa kibali ni yule mnyenyekevu, mwenye roho iliyovunjika, \q anayetetemeka kwa neno {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: Nilifanya vitu hivi vyote {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, \q na ndiyo sababu vipo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Ninapendezwa na watu walio wanyenyekevu na wenye roho iliyovunjika, \q watu wanaotetemeka kwa heshima kwa yale ninayosema.

decisions.choice: and all these came to be: everything exists because God made it
decisions.reason: The clause gives the result of God's making: the heavens and the earth of verse 1 exist only because his hand made them (Genesis 1). The Septuagint reads "and all these are mine".

decisions.choice: I will look to: I will regard with favor; afflicted and stricken in spirit: lowly and humbled before God
decisions.reason: To look to someone is to pay attention to him with favor (Genesis 4:4-5). The one God looks to is not the builder of a grand house but the poor and humbled person (57:15; Psalm 34:19; 51:19).

decisions.choice: trembling at my word: taking God's word with deep reverence and fear of disobeying it
decisions.reason: The same people are addressed in verse 5 and in Ezra 9:4 and 10:3, where those who tremble at God's commands are those who obey them.

decisions.choice: I am pleased with
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "I will look to" means here: God looks with favor.

source.text: שׁוֹחֵ֨ט הַשּׁ֜וֹר מַכֵּה־אִ֗ישׁ זוֹבֵ֤חַ הַשֶּׂה֙ עֹ֣רֵֽף כֶּ֔לֶב מַעֲלֵ֤ה מִנְחָה֙ דַּם־חֲזִ֔יר מַזְכִּ֥יר לְבֹנָ֖ה מְבָ֣רֵֽךְ אָ֑וֶן גַּם־הֵ֗מָּה בָּֽחֲרוּ֙ בְּדַרְכֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְשִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם נַפְשָׁ֥ם חָפֵֽצָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [One] slaughtering the ox, striking a man; sacrificing the lamb, breaking a dog's neck; offering up a grain offering, pig's blood; making a memorial of frankincense, blessing wickedness. Also they have chosen their ways, and in their detestable things their soul delights.

en.L: [One who] slaughters the ox [is like one who] strikes down a man; \q [one who] sacrifices the lamb, [like one who] breaks a dog's neck; \q [one who] offers up a grain offering, [like one who offers] pig's blood; \q [one who] burns frankincense as a memorial, [like one who] blesses an idol. \q They also have chosen their [own] ways, \q and their soul delights in their detestable things.
en.B: Slaughtering an ox is no different from killing a person; \q sacrificing a lamb, from breaking a dog's neck; \q presenting a grain offering, from offering pig's blood; \q burning frankincense as a memorial, from blessing an idol. \q These people have chosen their own ways, \q and their hearts delight in their loathsome things.
en.R: When these people kill an ox as a sacrifice, it is as bad as murdering someone. When they sacrifice a lamb, it is as bad as breaking a dog's neck. \q When they bring a grain offering, it is like offering the blood of a pig. \q When they burn sweet incense as an offering, it is like worshiping an idol. \q They have chosen to go their own way, \q and they love the disgusting things they do.

es.L: [El que] degüella un buey [es como el que] mata a un hombre; \q [el que] sacrifica un cordero, [como el que] desnuca a un perro; \q [el que] presenta ofrenda de grano, [como el que ofrece] sangre de cerdo; \q [el que] quema incienso como memorial, [como el que] bendice a un ídolo. \q También ellos han escogido sus [propios] caminos, \q y su alma se deleita en sus abominaciones.
es.B: Degollar un buey no es distinto de matar a una persona; \q sacrificar un cordero, de desnucar a un perro; \q presentar una ofrenda de grano, de ofrecer sangre de cerdo; \q quemar incienso como memorial, de bendecir a un ídolo. \q Esta gente ha escogido sus propios caminos, \q y su corazón se deleita en sus cosas detestables.
es.R: Cuando esta gente mata un buey como sacrificio, es tan malo como asesinar a alguien. Cuando sacrifica un cordero, es tan malo como desnucar a un perro. \q Cuando trae una ofrenda de grano, es como ofrecer sangre de cerdo. \q Cuando quema incienso aromático como ofrenda, es como adorar a un ídolo. \q Han escogido ir por su propio camino, \q y aman las cosas repugnantes que hacen.

fr.L: [Celui qui] égorge le bœuf [est comme celui qui] frappe un homme ; \q [celui qui] sacrifie l’agneau, [comme celui qui] brise la nuque d’un chien ; \q [celui qui] présente une offrande végétale, [comme celui qui offre] du sang de porc ; \q [celui qui] fait brûler l’encens en mémorial, [comme celui qui] bénit une idole. \q Eux aussi ont choisi leurs [propres] voies, \q et leur âme prend plaisir à leurs abominations.
fr.B: Égorger un bœuf ne vaut pas mieux que tuer un homme ; \q sacrifier un agneau, pas mieux que briser la nuque d’un chien ; \q présenter une offrande végétale, pas mieux qu’offrir du sang de porc ; \q brûler l’encens en mémorial, pas mieux que bénir une idole. \q Ces gens ont choisi leurs propres chemins, \q et leur cœur se plaît dans leurs horreurs.
fr.R: Quand ces gens tuent un bœuf en sacrifice, c’est aussi grave que de tuer quelqu’un. Quand ils sacrifient un agneau, c’est aussi grave que de briser la nuque d’un chien. \q Quand ils apportent une offrande de céréales, c’est comme s’ils offraient du sang de porc. \q Quand ils brûlent de l’encens parfumé en offrande, c’est comme s’ils adoraient une idole. \q Ils ont choisi de suivre leur propre chemin, \q et ils aiment les choses répugnantes qu’ils font.

sw.L: [Yeye] achinjaye ng'ombe [ni kama yeye] auaye mtu; \q [yeye] atoaye dhabihu ya mwana-kondoo, [kama yeye] avunjaye shingo ya mbwa; \q [yeye] atoaye sadaka ya nafaka, [kama yeye atoaye] damu ya nguruwe; \q [yeye] afukizaye ubani kuwa ukumbusho, [kama yeye] abarikiye sanamu. \q Wao pia wamechagua njia zao [wenyewe], \q na nafsi yao inafurahia machukizo yao.
sw.B: Kuchinja ng'ombe si tofauti na kuua mtu; \q kutoa dhabihu ya mwana-kondoo, si tofauti na kuvunja shingo ya mbwa; \q kutoa sadaka ya nafaka, si tofauti na kutoa damu ya nguruwe; \q kufukiza ubani kuwa ukumbusho, si tofauti na kubariki sanamu. \q Watu hawa wamechagua njia zao wenyewe, \q na mioyo yao inafurahia machukizo yao.
sw.R: Watu hawa wanapochinja ng'ombe kuwa dhabihu, ni vibaya kama kuua mtu. Wanapotoa dhabihu ya mwana-kondoo, ni vibaya kama kuvunja shingo ya mbwa. \q Wanapoleta sadaka ya nafaka, ni kama kutoa damu ya nguruwe. \q Wanapofukiza ubani wenye harufu nzuri kuwa sadaka, ni kama kuabudu sanamu. \q Wamechagua kwenda njia yao wenyewe, \q nao wanapenda mambo ya kuchukiza wanayoyafanya.

decisions.choice: one who slaughters an ox is like one who kills a person: each lawful sacrifice is set beside a crime and counted as no better
alternatives: the same people who sacrifice an ox also kill a person
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets each pair side by side with no verb. Read as a comparison, the verse says that when people who do not tremble at God's word (verse 2) bring sacrifices, God counts them as murder and idolatry (1:11-15). It can also be read as two acts of the same people: they sacrifice an ox and also kill a person, offer a lamb and also a dog. The comparison is taken here; the sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: dog and pig: unclean animals that could never be offered
decisions.reason: The pig was unclean (Leviticus 11:7; Deuteronomy 14:8), and a dog's price could not be brought into God's house (Deuteronomy 23:19). Breaking the neck was how the firstborn of a donkey was killed when it was not redeemed (Exodus 13:13). See also 65:4 and 66:17.

decisions.choice: burns frankincense as a memorial: the memorial portion of the grain offering; blesses an idol: honors a false god
decisions.reason: The verb is linked to the "memorial portion" burned with frankincense (Leviticus 2:2). The word for "wickedness" is used for idols and idolatry (1 Samuel 15:23; Hosea 10:5, 8, where Beth-el is mocked as Beth-aven, "house of wickedness").

decisions.choice: is no different from
decisions.reason: Balanced expresses the comparison of meaning decision m1 with "is no different from" rather than repeating "is like" in every line.

decisions.choice: When these people ...; it is as bad as; burn sweet incense as an offering
decisions.reason: Readable makes the comparison explicit as "it is as bad as" and names who is meant. It explains frankincense as sweet incense.

source.text: גַּם־אֲנִ֞י אֶבְחַ֣ר בְּתַעֲלֻלֵיהֶ֗ם וּמְגֽוּרֹתָם֙ אָבִ֣יא לָהֶ֔ם יַ֤עַן קָרָ֨אתִי֙ וְאֵ֣ין עוֹנֶ֔ה דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־חָפַ֖צְתִּי בָּחָֽרוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Also I will choose their harsh dealings, and their fears I will bring to them, because I called and there was none answering, I spoke and they did not listen; and they did the evil in my eyes, and in what I did not delight they chose.

en.L: I also will choose their harsh treatment, and what they dread I will bring on them, \q because I called and no one answered, \q I spoke and they did not listen; \q and they did what [was] evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes, \q and what I did not delight in they chose.
en.B: So I in turn will choose how harshly to deal with them and will bring on them the very things they fear. \q For when I called, no one replied; \q when I spoke, they would not listen. \q They did what was evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight \q and chose what gives {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} no pleasure.
en.R: So I will choose how to punish them. I will make the things they are afraid of happen to them. \q I called to them, but no one answered. \q I spoke, but they did not listen. \q They did what I consider evil. \q They chose to do things that do not please {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: También yo escogeré sus tratos crueles, y lo que temen traeré sobre ellos, \q porque llamé y nadie respondió, \q hablé y no escucharon; \q sino que hicieron lo malo ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, \q y escogieron lo que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada.
es.B: Así que yo, a mi vez, escogeré con qué dureza tratarlos y traeré sobre ellos lo mismo que temen. \q Porque cuando llamé, nadie respondió; \q cuando hablé, no quisieron escuchar. \q Hicieron lo que es malo a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos \q y escogieron lo que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada.
es.R: Así que yo escogeré cómo castigarlos. Haré que les pase lo que tanto temen. \q Los llamé, pero nadie respondió. \q Les hablé, pero no escucharon. \q Hicieron lo que yo considero malo. \q Escogieron hacer cosas que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agradan.

fr.L: Moi aussi, je choisirai leurs mauvais traitements, et ce qu’ils redoutent, je le ferai venir sur eux, \q parce que j’ai appelé et personne n’a répondu, \q j’ai parlé et ils n’ont pas écouté ; \q et ils ont fait ce qui [est] mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, \q et ce qui ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaît pas, ils l’ont choisi.
fr.B: Alors moi aussi, je choisirai la manière dure de les traiter et je ferai venir sur eux ce qu’ils craignent. \q Car lorsque j’ai appelé, personne n’a répondu ; \q lorsque j’ai parlé, ils n’ont pas voulu écouter. \q Ils ont fait ce qui est mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux \q et ont choisi ce qui ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaît pas.
fr.R: Alors je choisirai comment les punir. Je ferai arriver sur eux les choses dont ils ont peur. \q Je les ai appelés, mais personne n’a répondu. \q J’ai parlé, mais ils n’ont pas écouté. \q Ils ont fait ce que je trouve mauvais. \q Ils ont choisi de faire des choses qui ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaisent pas.

sw.L: Mimi pia nitachagua mateso yao makali, na wanachokiogopa nitakileta juu yao, \q kwa sababu niliita wala hakuna aliyejibu, \q nilisema wala hawakusikiliza; \q nao walitenda yaliyo maovu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, \q na lile nisilolipenda wakalichagua.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} kwa upande {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} nitachagua jinsi ya kuwashughulikia kwa ukali, na kuleta juu yao mambo yale yale wanayoyaogopa. \q Kwa maana nilipoita, hakuna aliyejibu; \q niliposema, hawakutaka kusikiliza. \q Walitenda yaliyo maovu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} \q na kuchagua yasiyonipendeza.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitachagua jinsi ya kuwaadhibu. Nitayafanya mambo wanayoyaogopa yawapate. \q Niliwaita, lakini hakuna aliyejibu. \q Nilisema, lakini hawakusikiliza. \q Walitenda mambo ninayoyaona kuwa maovu. \q Walichagua kufanya mambo yasiyonipendeza.

decisions.choice: they have chosen ... I also will choose: God answers their choice with his own
decisions.reason: Verse 3 ends "they too have chosen", and verse 4 begins "I too will choose". The repeated verb shows that God's judgment matches what the people chose.

decisions.choice: harsh treatment: dealings that make sport of them, punishments that fit their folly
decisions.reason: The noun occurs elsewhere only in 3:4, where it refers to capricious or childish rulers. Here it means God's harsh dealing with those who made a mockery of worship. The exact sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: I called and no one answered: the same charge as 65:12
decisions.reason: The last four lines repeat 65:12 almost word for word, tying the two chapters together. See also 50:2.

decisions.choice: how to punish them; what I consider evil
decisions.reason: Readable says "punish" for the harsh treatment and explains "evil in my eyes".

source.text: שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר־יְהוָ֔ה הַחֲרֵדִ֖ים אֶל־דְּבָר֑וֹ אָמְרוּ֩ אֲחֵיכֶ֨ם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶ֜ם מְנַדֵּיכֶ֗ם לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ יִכְבַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה וְנִרְאֶ֥ה בְשִׂמְחַתְכֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם יֵבֹֽשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear [the] word of Yahweh, the [ones] trembling at his word: Your brothers have said, [those] hating you, [those] thrusting you out for the sake of my name, Let Yahweh be glorified, and we will look on your joy; and they will be ashamed.

en.L: Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [you who] tremble at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word: \q {{gender:Your brothers and sisters|Your brothers}} who hate you, who thrust you out for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, have said, "Let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be glorified, \q so that we may see your joy!" But they will be put to shame.
en.B: Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who tremble at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word: \q Your own kin, who hate you and cast you out because of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, have said, "Let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q and we will see how glad you are!" But it is they who will be put to shame.
en.R: Listen to the message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who tremble with awe at what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says. \q Your own people hate you. They push you away because you belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They say, "Let {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} show how great {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is! \q Then we will see you happy!" But they are the ones who will be put to shame.

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q los que tiemblan ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra: \q {{plural_you:Sus hermanos que los aborrecen, que los echan fuera|Vuestros hermanos que os aborrecen, que os echan fuera}} por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, han dicho: «Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sea glorificado, \q para que veamos {{plural_you:su alegría|vuestra alegría}}». Pero ellos serán avergonzados.
es.B: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que tiemblan|vosotros que tembláis}} ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra: \q {{plural_you:Sus propios hermanos, que los odian y los echan|Vuestros propios hermanos, que os odian y os echan}} por causa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, han dicho: «Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q ¡y veremos lo contentos que {{plural_you:están|estáis}}!». Pero son ellos los que serán avergonzados.
es.R: {{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q {{plural_you:ustedes que tiemblan|vosotros que tembláis}} con reverencia ante lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice. \q {{plural_you:Su propia gente los odia. Los echan porque ustedes me pertenecen|Vuestra propia gente os odia. Os echan porque vosotros me pertenecéis}}. Dicen: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} muestre lo grande que es! \q ¡Así {{plural_you:los|os}} veremos felices!». Pero son ellos los que serán avergonzados.

fr.L: Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q [vous qui] tremblez à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole : \q {{gender:Vos frères et sœurs|Vos frères}} qui vous haïssent, qui vous rejettent à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, ont dit : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se glorifie, \q pour que nous voyions votre joie ! » Mais eux seront couverts de honte.
fr.B: Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q vous qui tremblez à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole : \q Vos proches, qui vous haïssent et vous chassent à cause de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, ont dit : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q et nous verrons combien vous êtes joyeux ! » Mais ce sont eux qui seront couverts de honte.
fr.R: Écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q vous qui tremblez avec respect devant ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit. \q Les gens de votre propre peuple vous détestent. Ils vous rejettent parce que vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartenez. Ils disent : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montre combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand ! \q Alors nous vous verrons heureux ! » Mais ce sont eux qui seront couverts de honte.

sw.L: Sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q [ninyi] mnaotetemeka kwa neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}: \q Ndugu zenu wanaowachukia, wanaowafukuza kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, wamesema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na atukuzwe, \q ili tuone furaha yenu!" Lakini wao wataaibishwa.
sw.B: Sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ninyi mnaotetemeka kwa neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}: \q Ndugu zenu wenyewe, wanaowachukia na kuwafukuza kwa sababu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, wamesema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na aonyeshe utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q nasi tutaona jinsi mlivyo na furaha!" Lakini ni wao watakaoaibishwa.
sw.R: Sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ninyi mnaotetemeka kwa heshima kwa yale anayosema. \q Watu wenu wenyewe wanawachukia. Wanawasukuma mbali kwa sababu ninyi ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Wanasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na aonyeshe jinsi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} alivyo mkuu! \q Ndipo tutawaona mkiwa na furaha!" Lakini wao ndio watakaoaibishwa.

decisions.choice: your brothers: fellow Israelites who reject the faithful
decisions.reason: The faithful who tremble at God's word (verse 2) are hated and shut out by members of their own people. Jesus speaks of the same treatment in Luke 6:22.

decisions.choice: for the sake of my name: they exclude the faithful because of their loyalty to God
alternatives: claiming to act for the sake of my name
decisions.reason: The phrase may describe why the faithful are cast out (because they bear God's name) or the excuse of those who cast them out (they claim to act for God's name). Either way the faithful suffer for the LORD.

decisions.choice: Let the LORD be glorified, so that we may see your joy: a mocking taunt
decisions.reason: The words dare God to act and the faithful to show the joy they hope for. God's answer comes in verses 6-14, where the mockers are shamed and the faithful rejoice.

decisions.choice: because you belong to me
decisions.reason: Readable explains "for the sake of my name" as the reason the faithful are rejected: they are God's people.

decisions.choice: hermanos (no gender span)
decisions.reason: Spanish "hermanos" already includes sisters, so the English gender span (brothers and sisters / brothers) has no Spanish counterpart, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: Sikieni neno la YHWH (Literal); Sikilizeni neno la YHWH (Balanced); Sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa YHWH (Readable); ndugu zenu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Hear the word of the LORD" in the wording of 2 Kings 20:16. "Ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so the English gender span has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "Écoutez la parole du SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "Écoutez le message du SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording settled for Isaiah and Jeremiah; at Literal the English gender span on "your brothers" becomes "{{gender:Vos frères et sœurs|Vos frères}}", as in the New Testament letters.

source.text: ק֤וֹל שָׁאוֹן֙ מֵעִ֔יר ק֖וֹל מֵֽהֵיכָ֑ל ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁלֵּ֥ם גְּמ֖וּל לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sound of an uproar from [the] city, a sound from [the] temple, [the] sound of Yahweh repaying recompense to his enemies.

en.L: A sound of uproar from the city! \q A sound from the temple! \q The sound of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} paying back recompense to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies!
en.B: Hear that roar from the city! \q Hear the noise from the temple! \q It is the sound of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} paying back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies what they have earned.
en.R: Listen! There is a loud noise coming from the city and from the temple. \q It is the noise of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} punishes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies as they deserve.

es.L: ¡Voz de estruendo desde la ciudad! \q ¡Voz desde el templo! \q ¡La voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que da la retribución a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} ese estruendo que viene de la ciudad! \q ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} el ruido que viene del templo! \q Es la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que les paga a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos lo que se han ganado.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Se oye un gran ruido que viene de la ciudad y del templo. \q Es el ruido {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} mientras castiga a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos como merecen.

fr.L: Un bruit de tumulte, de la ville ! \q Une voix, du temple ! \q La voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui rend à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis ce qu’ils méritent !
fr.B: Écoutez ce grondement qui vient de la ville ! \q Écoutez ce bruit qui vient du temple ! \q C’est la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui paie à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis ce qu’ils ont mérité.
fr.R: Écoutez ! Un grand bruit vient de la ville et du temple. \q C’est le bruit que fait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} punit {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis comme ils le méritent.

sw.L: Sauti ya ghasia kutoka mjini! \q Sauti kutoka hekaluni! \q Sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akiwalipa adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} malipo!
sw.B: Sikia mngurumo ule kutoka mjini! \q Sikia kelele kutoka hekaluni! \q Ni sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akiwalipa adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kile walichostahili.
sw.R: Sikilizeni! Kuna kelele kubwa inayotoka mjini na hekaluni. \q Ni kelele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapowaadhibu adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kama wanavyostahili.

decisions.choice: a sound: an exclamation calling for attention, "Listen!"
decisions.reason: The repeated word can mean "sound" or work as an exclamation, "Listen!" (40:3, 6; 52:8). Here it announces the noise of God's coming in judgment.

decisions.choice: the temple: God's house in Jerusalem, from which his judgment goes out
decisions.reason: The LORD acts from his temple (Amos 1:2; Micah 1:2). The word can also mean a palace, but beside "the city" it is the temple on Mount Zion.

source.text: בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּחִ֖יל יָלָ֑דָה בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָב֥וֹא חֵ֛בֶל לָ֖הּ וְהִמְלִ֥יטָה זָכָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Before she was in labor she gave birth; before pain came to her, and she delivered a male.

en.L: Before she was in labor, she gave birth; \q before [the] pain came to her, she delivered a male [child].
en.B: Before her labor began, she gave birth; \q before the pangs came over her, she brought a son into the world.
en.R: Zion is like a woman who gives birth before her labor even starts. \q Before she feels any pain, she has a baby boy.

es.L: Antes de estar de parto, dio a luz; \q antes de que le viniera el dolor, dio a luz un varón.
es.B: Antes de que comenzaran sus dolores, dio a luz; \q antes de que le vinieran las contracciones, trajo al mundo un hijo.
es.R: Sion es como una mujer que da a luz antes de que empiecen siquiera sus dolores de parto. \q Antes de sentir ningún dolor, tiene un niño.

fr.L: Avant d’être en travail, elle a enfanté ; \q avant que la douleur lui vienne, elle a mis au monde un [enfant] mâle.
fr.B: Avant que son travail commence, elle a enfanté ; \q avant que les douleurs la saisissent, elle a mis au monde un fils.
fr.R: Sion est comme une femme qui accouche avant même que le travail commence. \q Avant de sentir la moindre douleur, elle a un petit garçon.

sw.L: Kabla hajapata uchungu, alizaa; \q kabla maumivu hayajamjia, alizaa [mtoto] mwanamume.
sw.B: Kabla uchungu wake haujaanza, alijifungua; \q kabla maumivu hayajamjia, alizaa mtoto wa kiume.
sw.R: Sayuni ni kama mwanamke anayejifungua kabla uchungu wake haujaanza hata kidogo. \q Kabla hajasikia maumivu yoyote, amepata mtoto wa kiume.

decisions.choice: she: Zion, the mother city, whose son is a restored people
decisions.reason: Verse 8 names the mother as Zion. The sudden painless birth pictures God giving Jerusalem a new people all at once (49:20-21; 54:1).

decisions.choice: gave birth, delivered: the coming event told as already done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the form used for completed action; the prophet speaks of the future as certain, as in verse 8.

decisions.choice: Zion is like a woman who
decisions.reason: Readable names the mother, as verse 8 does, and makes the picture a comparison.

source.text: מִֽי־שָׁמַ֣ע כָּזֹ֗את מִ֤י רָאָה֙ כָּאֵ֔לֶּה הֲי֤וּחַל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד אִם־יִוָּ֥לֵֽד גּ֖וֹי פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּֽי־חָ֛לָה גַּם־יָלְדָ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן אֶת־בָּנֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Who has heard like this? Who has seen like these? Will a land be brought to birth in one day? Or will a nation be born [at] one time? For she was in labor, also she gave birth, Zion, to her children.

en.L: Who has heard [anything] like this? Who has seen [things] like these? \q Will a land be brought to birth in one day? \q Or will a nation be born at one time? \q Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
en.B: Who ever heard of anything like this? Who has seen the like? \q Is a country brought to birth in a single day, \q or a nation born in one moment? \q Yet Zion had barely begun her labor when she bore her children.
en.R: No one has ever heard of anything like this! No one has ever seen such things! \q A whole country cannot be born in a single day. \q A nation cannot come into being in a moment. \q But as soon as Zion's labor began, her children were born.

es.L: ¿Quién ha oído [cosa] como esta? ¿Quién ha visto [cosas] como estas? \q ¿Nacerá una tierra en un solo día? \q ¿O nacerá una nación de una vez? \q Pues en cuanto Sion estuvo de parto, dio a luz a sus hijos.
es.B: ¿Quién ha oído jamás algo así? ¿Quién ha visto cosa semejante? \q ¿Nace un país en un solo día, \q o una nación en un solo momento? \q Pero apenas comenzó Sion su parto, dio a luz a sus hijos.
es.R: ¡Nadie ha oído nunca algo así! ¡Nadie ha visto nunca cosas semejantes! \q Un país entero no puede nacer en un solo día. \q Una nación no puede llegar a existir en un momento. \q Pero en cuanto comenzaron los dolores de parto de Sion, nacieron sus hijos.

fr.L: Qui a entendu [rien de] pareil ? Qui a vu [des choses] semblables ? \q Un pays est-il enfanté en un seul jour ? \q Ou une nation naît-elle en une seule fois ? \q Pourtant, à peine en travail, Sion a enfanté ses enfants.
fr.B: Qui a jamais entendu pareille chose ? Qui a jamais vu rien de tel ? \q Un pays naît-il en un seul jour, \q une nation vient-elle au monde en un instant ? \q Pourtant, Sion avait à peine commencé son travail qu’elle a mis au monde ses enfants.
fr.R: Personne n’a jamais entendu parler d’une chose pareille ! Personne n’a jamais rien vu de tel ! \q Un pays tout entier ne peut pas naître en un seul jour. \q Une nation ne peut pas venir au monde en un instant. \q Mais dès que le travail de Sion a commencé, ses enfants sont nés.

sw.L: Ni nani aliyesikia [jambo] kama hili? Ni nani aliyeona [mambo] kama haya? \q Je, nchi itazaliwa katika siku moja? \q Au taifa litazaliwa mara moja? \q Lakini mara tu Sayuni alipoingia uchungu, alizaa watoto wake.
sw.B: Ni nani aliyewahi kusikia jambo kama hili? Ni nani aliyeona mfano wake? \q Je, nchi huzaliwa katika siku moja, \q au taifa huzaliwa katika dakika moja? \q Hata hivyo Sayuni alikuwa ameanza tu uchungu wake alipowazaa watoto wake.
sw.R: Hakuna aliyewahi kusikia jambo kama hili! Hakuna aliyewahi kuona mambo kama haya! \q Nchi nzima haiwezi kuzaliwa katika siku moja. \q Taifa haliwezi kutokea kwa dakika moja. \q Lakini mara tu uchungu wa Sayuni ulipoanza, watoto wake walizaliwa.

decisions.choice: as soon as she was in labor, she gave birth: labor and birth came together
decisions.reason: The words "for ... also" join the two verbs so that the birth follows the first pain at once. This answers the questions: what never happens in nature God will do for Zion.

decisions.choice: her children: the people of Zion, gathered and restored
decisions.reason: Zion's children are her inhabitants and the exiles who return to her (49:17-22; 54:1-3; 60:4).

decisions.choice: A whole country cannot be born ... A nation cannot come into being
decisions.reason: Readable turns the questions, which expect the answer "no", into statements.

source.text: הַאֲנִ֥י אַשְׁבִּ֛יר וְלֹ֥א אוֹלִ֖יד יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־אֲנִ֧י הַמּוֹלִ֛יד וְעָצַ֖רְתִּי אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Do I bring to the breaking-point and not cause to give birth? says Yahweh. Or [am] I the [one] causing to give birth and I shut? says your God.

en.L: Will I bring to the point of breaking and not cause to give birth? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Or [am] I the one who causes to give birth, and [then] I shut [the womb]? says your God.
en.B: Would I bring on the birth and then not let the child be born? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Would I, who bring children to birth, then hold them back? says your God.
en.R: I would never bring a mother to the moment of birth and then stop her baby from being born, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I am the one who makes birth happen. I would never close the womb, says your God.

es.L: ¿Llevaré yo hasta el punto de nacer y no haré dar a luz?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q ¿O [soy] yo el que hace dar a luz, y [luego] cierro [el seno]?, dice tu Dios.
es.B: ¿Iniciaría yo el parto y luego no dejaría nacer al niño?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q ¿Yo, que hago nacer a los hijos, los retendría?, dice tu Dios.
es.R: Yo nunca llevaría a una madre al momento de dar a luz para luego impedir que naciera su bebé, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Yo soy el que hace que se produzca el nacimiento. Nunca cerraría el seno materno, dice tu Dios.

fr.L: Moi, ferais-je arriver jusqu’au passage sans faire enfanter ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Ou bien moi, qui fais enfanter, fermerais-je [le sein] ? dit ton Dieu.
fr.B: Ferais-je venir la naissance sans laisser naître l’enfant ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Moi qui fais naître, retiendrais-je l’enfant ? dit ton Dieu.
fr.R: Jamais je n’amènerais une mère au moment de la naissance pour ensuite empêcher son bébé de naître, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q C’est moi qui fais naître les enfants. Jamais je ne fermerais le ventre de la mère, dit ton Dieu.

sw.L: Je, nitaleta hadi wakati wa kuzaa na nisizalishe? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Au {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niliye mzalishaji, [kisha] nifunge [tumbo]? asema Mungu wako.
sw.B: Je, ningeleta uchungu wa kuzaa kisha nisimwache mtoto azaliwe? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Je, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, ninayewaleta watoto wazaliwe, ningewazuia? asema Mungu wako.
sw.R: Kamwe sitamleta mama hadi wakati wa kuzaa kisha nimzuie mtoto wake asizaliwe, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Mimi ndiye ninayefanya watoto wazaliwe. Kamwe sitalifunga tumbo, anasema Mungu wako.

decisions.choice: bring to the breaking point and not cause to give birth: God reverses the lament of 37:3
decisions.reason: In 37:3 Hezekiah said, "Children have come to the breaking point, and there is no strength to give birth." The same rare root for the opening of the womb returns here: what Judah could not do then, God will do for Zion.

decisions.choice: shut: close the womb, hold back the birth
decisions.reason: The verb is used of God closing the womb (Genesis 16:2; 20:18). Both questions expect the answer "no": God will finish what he has begun.

decisions.choice: I would never ...; I would never close the womb
decisions.reason: Readable turns the questions, which expect the answer "no", into statements.

source.text: שִׂמְח֧וּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְגִ֥ילוּ בָ֖הּ כָּל־אֹהֲבֶ֑יהָ שִׂ֤ישׂוּ אִתָּהּ֙ מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ כָּל־הַמִּֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עָלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad in her, all [ones] loving her; exult with her [in] joy, all the [ones] mourning over her,

en.L: Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad in her, all [you who] love her; \q exult with her [in] joy, all [you who] mourn over her,
en.B: Celebrate with Jerusalem and be glad over her, all who love her. \q Join in her great joy, all who have grieved for her,
en.R: Be happy with Jerusalem! Celebrate because of her, all of you who love her! \q You have been sad about her, but now you can share her great joy.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} con Jerusalén y {{plural_you:regocíjense|regocijaos}} por ella, todos los que la aman; \q {{plural_you:gócense|gozaos}} con ella [con] gozo, todos los que lloran por ella,
es.B: {{plural_you:Celebren|Celebrad}} con Jerusalén y {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} por ella, todos los que la aman. \q {{plural_you:Únanse|Uníos}} a su gran alegría, todos los que han llorado por ella,
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} felices con Jerusalén! ¡{{plural_you:Celebren|Celebrad}} por ella, todos los que la aman! \q {{plural_you:Han estado tristes|Habéis estado tristes}} por ella, pero ahora {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} compartir su gran alegría.

fr.L: Réjouissez-vous avec Jérusalem et soyez dans l’allégresse à cause d’elle, vous tous qui l’aimez ; \q tressaillez de joie avec elle, vous tous qui étiez en deuil à cause d’elle,
fr.B: Faites la fête avec Jérusalem et réjouissez-vous pour elle, vous tous qui l’aimez. \q Prenez part à sa grande joie, vous tous qui avez pleuré sur elle,
fr.R: Soyez heureux avec Jérusalem ! Faites la fête à cause d’elle, vous tous qui l’aimez ! \q Vous avez été tristes à cause d’elle, mais maintenant vous pouvez partager sa grande joie.

sw.L: Furahini pamoja na Yerusalemu na kushangilia kwa ajili yake, nyote [mnaoupenda]; \q shangilieni pamoja nao [kwa] furaha, nyote [mnaoulilia],
sw.B: Sherehekeeni pamoja na Yerusalemu na kufurahi juu yake, nyote mnaoupenda. \q Jiungeni katika furaha yake kuu, nyote mliouombolezea,
sw.R: Furahini pamoja na Yerusalemu! Sherehekeeni kwa sababu yake, ninyi nyote mnaoupenda! \q Mmekuwa na huzuni juu yake, lakini sasa mnaweza kushiriki furaha yake kuu.

decisions.choice: rejoice, be glad, exult: a call to joy that runs on into verse 11
decisions.reason: Three verbs of joy are piled up. The call continues into verse 11, which gives its purpose: that they may share in Jerusalem's comfort.

decisions.choice: those who mourn over her: the faithful who grieved for ruined Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Mourning for Zion's ruin marks the faithful (57:18; 61:2-3; Lamentations 1:4). Now their grief turns to joy.

decisions.choice: You have been sad about her, but now
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the change from mourning to joy that the verse implies, and ends the sentence here.

source.text: לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽינְקוּ֙ וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֔ם מִשֹּׁ֖ד תַּנְחֻמֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֧עַן תָּמֹ֛צּוּ וְהִתְעַנַּגְתֶּ֖ם מִזִּ֥יז כְּבוֹדָֽהּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: so that you may nurse and be satisfied from [the] breast of her consolations, so that you may drain and delight yourselves from [the] abundance of her glory.

en.L: so that you may nurse and be satisfied from the breast of her consolations, \q so that you may drink deeply and take delight from the abundance of her glory.
en.B: so that you may feed at her breast and find comfort and be full, \q and draw your fill and revel in her rich glory.
en.R: Jerusalem will be like a mother to you. She will comfort you as a mother feeds her baby. \q You will be full and satisfied with all the good things she has.

es.L: para que {{plural_you:mamen y se sacien|maméis y os saciéis}} del pecho de sus consolaciones, \q para que {{plural_you:beban hasta saciarse y se deleiten|bebáis hasta saciaros y os deleitéis}} con la abundancia de su gloria.
es.B: para que {{plural_you:se alimenten de su pecho, encuentren consuelo y queden satisfechos|os alimentéis de su pecho, encontréis consuelo y quedéis satisfechos}}, \q y {{plural_you:beban hasta saciarse y disfruten|bebáis hasta saciaros y disfrutéis}} de su rica gloria.
es.R: Jerusalén será como una madre para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} consolará como una madre alimenta a su bebé. \q {{plural_you:Quedarán satisfechos|Quedaréis satisfechos}} con todas las cosas buenas que ella tiene.

fr.L: afin que vous tétiez et soyez rassasiés au sein de ses consolations, \q afin que vous buviez à longs traits et fassiez vos délices de l’abondance de sa gloire.
fr.B: pour que vous vous nourrissiez à son sein, consolés et rassasiés, \q et que vous buviez à satiété et vous régaliez de sa riche gloire.
fr.R: Jérusalem sera comme une mère pour vous. Elle vous consolera comme une mère nourrit son bébé. \q Vous serez rassasiés et comblés de toutes les bonnes choses qu’elle possède.

sw.L: ili mnyonye na kushiba kutoka kwenye titi la faraja zake, \q ili mnywe sana na kujifurahisha kutoka kwa wingi wa utukufu wake.
sw.B: ili mnyonye maziwa yake na kupata faraja na kushiba, \q na kunywa mpaka mtosheke na kufurahia utukufu wake mwingi.
sw.R: Yerusalemu utakuwa kama mama kwenu. Utawafariji kama mama anavyomnyonyesha mtoto wake. \q Mtashiba na kuridhika na mambo yote mema aliyo nayo.

decisions.choice: the abundance of her glory: Jerusalem's rich supply, pictured as a nursing mother's flowing milk
decisions.reason: The word translated "abundance" occurs only here; it may mean the nipple, or the flow of milk. "Glory" here includes wealth and plenty, as in verse 12 ("the glory of the nations") and 61:6.

decisions.choice: the breast of her consolations: comfort given as a mother feeds a child
decisions.reason: Jerusalem is pictured as a mother who nurses her children (60:16; 49:23). Verse 13 shows that the comfort is God's own.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem will be like a mother to you
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture of Jerusalem as a nursing mother explicit and begins a new sentence.

source.text: כִּֽי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹטֶֽה־אֵ֠לֶיהָ כְּנָהָ֨ר שָׁל֜וֹם וּכְנַ֧חַל שׁוֹטֵ֛ף כְּב֥וֹד גּוֹיִ֖ם וִֽינַקְתֶּ֑ם עַל־צַד֙ תִּנָּשֵׂ֔אוּ וְעַל־בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תְּשָׁעֳשָֽׁעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: Look, I [am] extending to her like a river peace, and like an overflowing torrent [the] glory of nations; and you will nurse; on [the] hip you will be carried, and on [the] knees you will be dandled.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Look, I [am] about to extend peace to her like a river, \q and the glory of [the] nations like an overflowing torrent; and you will nurse; \q on [the] hip you will be carried, \q and on [the] knees you will be dandled.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Look, I will make peace flow to her like a river, \q and the wealth of the nations like a stream in flood. You will feed at her breast; \q she will carry you at her side \q and play with you on her knees.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I will give Jerusalem peace that flows like a river. The riches of the nations will pour into her like a flooding stream. \q You will be like babies that nurse at their mother's breast. \q She will carry you on her hip and play with you on her lap.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, yo extiendo sobre ella la paz como un río, \q y la gloria de las naciones como torrente desbordado; y {{plural_you:mamarán|mamaréis}}; \q sobre la cadera {{plural_you:serán llevados|seréis llevados}}, \q y sobre las rodillas {{plural_you:serán mimados|seréis mimados}}.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, haré que la paz fluya hacia ella como un río, \q y la riqueza de las naciones como un torrente crecido. {{plural_you:Se alimentarán|Os alimentaréis}} de su pecho; \q ella {{plural_you:los|os}} llevará a su lado \q y jugará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sobre sus rodillas.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Daré a Jerusalén una paz que fluirá como un río. Las riquezas de las naciones entrarán en ella como un torrente crecido. \q {{plural_you:Serán|Seréis}} como bebés que maman del pecho de su madre. \q Ella {{plural_you:los|os}} llevará sobre la cadera y jugará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} sobre sus rodillas.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Voici, je vais étendre vers elle la paix comme un fleuve, \q et la gloire des nations comme un torrent qui déborde ; et vous téterez ; \q sur la hanche vous serez portés, \q et sur les genoux vous serez caressés.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Voici, je ferai couler vers elle la paix comme un fleuve, \q et la richesse des nations comme un torrent en crue. Vous vous nourrirez à son sein ; \q elle vous portera sur sa hanche \q et jouera avec vous sur ses genoux.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je donnerai à Jérusalem une paix qui coulera comme une rivière. Les richesses des nations se déverseront en elle comme un torrent en crue. \q Vous serez comme des bébés qui tètent le sein de leur mère. \q Elle vous portera sur sa hanche et jouera avec vous sur ses genoux.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, ninakaribia kuuelekezea amani kama mto, \q na utukufu wa mataifa kama kijito kinachofurika; nanyi mtanyonya; \q mtabebwa nyongani, \q na kubembelezwa magotini.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Tazama, nitaifanya amani iutiririkie kama mto, \q na utajiri wa mataifa kama kijito kilichofurika. Mtanyonya titi lake; \q atawabeba ubavuni pake \q na kuwachezesha magotini pake.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitaupa Yerusalemu amani inayotiririka kama mto. Utajiri wa mataifa utamiminika ndani yake kama kijito kilichofurika. \q Mtakuwa kama watoto wachanga wanaonyonya titi la mama yao. \q Atawabeba nyongani mwake na kuwachezesha mapajani mwake.

decisions.choice: peace like a river; the glory of the nations: lasting well-being and the wealth of the nations flowing into Zion
decisions.reason: Compare 48:18, where peace like a river was what Israel lost by not listening. "The glory of the nations" is their wealth, brought to Zion (60:5, 11; 61:6).

decisions.choice: carried on the hip, dandled on the knees: the care a mother gives an infant
decisions.reason: Small children were carried on the hip or side (60:4) and played with on the lap. The people are Zion's children (verse 8).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem; You will be like babies
decisions.reason: Readable names the city meant by "her" and makes the picture of nursing a comparison.

source.text: כְּאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִמּ֖וֹ תְּנַחֲמֶ֑נּוּ כֵּ֤ן אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֲנַ֣חֶמְכֶ֔ם וּבִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תְּנֻחָֽמוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Like a man whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you, and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.

en.L: Like one whom his mother comforts, \q so I will comfort you, \q and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.
en.B: Just as a mother comforts her own, \q so I myself will comfort you; \q in Jerusalem you will be comforted.
en.R: I will comfort you just as a mother comforts her son or daughter. \q You will find comfort in Jerusalem.

es.L: Como uno a quien su madre consuela, \q así yo {{plural_you:los|os}} consolaré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q y en Jerusalén {{plural_you:serán consolados|seréis consolados}}.
es.B: Así como una madre consuela a los suyos, \q así yo mismo {{plural_you:los|os}} consolaré; \q en Jerusalén {{plural_you:serán consolados|seréis consolados}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} consolaré como una madre consuela a su hijo o a su hija. \q {{plural_you:Encontrarán|Encontraréis}} consuelo en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Comme quelqu’un que sa mère console, \q ainsi moi, je vous consolerai, \q et dans Jérusalem vous serez consolés.
fr.B: Comme une mère console son enfant, \q ainsi je vous consolerai {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}} ; \q à Jérusalem vous serez consolés.
fr.R: Je vous consolerai comme une mère console son fils ou sa fille. \q Vous trouverez du réconfort à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Kama mtu ambaye mama yake humfariji, \q ndivyo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitakavyowafariji, \q nanyi mtafarijiwa katika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kama mama anavyomfariji mtoto wake, \q ndivyo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nitakavyowafariji; \q mtafarijiwa katika Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Nitawafariji kama mama anavyomfariji mwanawe au binti yake. \q Mtapata faraja katika Yerusalemu.

decisions.choice: as a mother comforts, so I will comfort you: God's own comfort is pictured as a mother's
decisions.reason: In verses 11-12 Jerusalem is the mother; now God himself comforts like a mother (49:15; 42:14). The word "comfort" comes three times in the verse and echoes the opening of this part of the book (40:1; 51:3, 12).

decisions.choice: one whom his mother comforts: a child of any age, even a grown person
decisions.reason: The word usually means a man or person, not an infant. The picture moves from a nursing baby (verses 11-12) to anyone who is comforted by his mother.

decisions.choice: I myself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the full, emphatic form of "I"; Balanced shows the emphasis with "I myself".

source.text: וּרְאִיתֶם֙ וְשָׂ֣שׂ לִבְּכֶ֔ם וְעַצְמוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם כַּדֶּ֣שֶׁא תִפְרַ֑חְנָה וְנוֹדְעָ֤ה יַד־יְהוָה֙ אֶת־עֲבָדָ֔יו וְזָעַ֖ם אֶת־אֹיְבָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will see, and your heart will rejoice, and your bones like the grass will sprout; and the hand of Yahweh will be known with his servants, and he will be indignant with his enemies.

en.L: And you will see, and your heart will rejoice, \q and your bones will sprout like [new] grass; \q and the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be made known with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rage against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies.
en.B: You will see this and your hearts will be glad; \q your bones will spring up like new grass. \q It will be known that the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be furious with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies.
en.R: When you see this, you will be very happy. \q Your bodies will grow strong again, like grass that grows in spring. \q Everyone will know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s power is with those who serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger against {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:lo verán, y se alegrará su corazón|lo veréis, y se alegrará vuestro corazón}}, \q y {{plural_you:sus huesos|vuestros huesos}} reverdecerán como la hierba; \q y la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se dará a conocer a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enfurecerá contra {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Verán esto y su corazón|Veréis esto y vuestro corazón}} se alegrará; \q {{plural_you:sus huesos|vuestros huesos}} brotarán como hierba nueva. \q Se sabrá que la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos, \q pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enfurecerá contra {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} esto, {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} muy felices. \q {{plural_you:Su cuerpo|Vuestro cuerpo}} volverá a ser fuerte, como la hierba que crece en primavera. \q Todos sabrán que el poder {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está con los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirven. \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mostrará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} enojo contra {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos.

fr.L: Et vous verrez, et votre cœur se réjouira, \q et vos os germeront comme l’herbe [nouvelle] ; \q et la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se fera connaître envers {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’indignera contre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis.
fr.B: Vous le verrez, et votre cœur sera dans la joie ; \q vos os reprendront vie comme l’herbe nouvelle. \q On saura que la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est avec {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera furieux contre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis.
fr.R: Quand vous verrez cela, vous serez très heureux. \q Votre corps reprendra des forces, comme l’herbe qui pousse au printemps. \q Tout le monde saura que la puissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est avec ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servent. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère contre {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis.

sw.L: Nanyi mtaona, na moyo wenu utashangilia, \q na mifupa yenu itachipuka kama majani [machanga]; \q na mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utajulikana pamoja na watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q naye atawaghadhibikia adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Mtaona jambo hili na mioyo yenu itafurahi; \q mifupa yenu itachipuka kama majani mabichi. \q Itajulikana kwamba mkono wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uko pamoja na watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q lakini atawakasirikia sana adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Mtakapoona hayo, mtafurahi sana. \q Miili yenu itapata nguvu tena, kama majani yanayoota wakati wa mvua. \q Kila mtu atajua kwamba uweza wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uko pamoja na wale wanaomtumikia. \q Lakini ataonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} dhidi ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.

decisions.choice: your bones will sprout like grass: your whole being will be renewed
decisions.reason: The bones stand for the body and the whole person (58:11; Proverbs 3:8; 15:30). Dried-up bones flourish again like fresh grass after rain.

decisions.choice: the hand of the LORD with his servants: his power shown on behalf of those who serve him
decisions.reason: "Hand" means power. "His servants" here are the faithful of verses 2 and 5, set against "his enemies" (65:8-15).

decisions.choice: Your bodies will grow strong again; the LORD's power
decisions.reason: Readable explains the bones as the body and the hand as power.

source.text: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּאֵ֣שׁ יָב֔וֹא וְכַסּוּפָ֖ה מַרְכְּבֹתָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֤יב בְּחֵמָה֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְגַעֲרָת֖וֹ בְּלַהֲבֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, Yahweh in fire will come, and like the storm-wind his chariots, to return in fury his anger and his rebuke in flames of fire.

en.L: For look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will come in fire, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chariots like the storm wind, \q to pay back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger in fury, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rebuke in flames of fire.
en.B: Look! {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes in fire, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} chariots sweep in like a storm, \q to give vent to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger in fury \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rebuke in tongues of fire.
en.R: Look! {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is coming with fire! \q His chariots are coming like a storm. \q He will pay back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} burning anger. \q He will punish them with flames of fire.

es.L: Porque, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vendrá en fuego, \q y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} carros como torbellino, \q para descargar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira con furor, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reprensión con llamas de fuego.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} viene en fuego, \q y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} carros llegan como una tormenta, \q para desahogar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira con furor \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reprensión con lenguas de fuego.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} viene con fuego. \q Sus carros vienen como una tormenta. \q Les pagará a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ardiente enojo. \q Los castigará con llamas de fuego.

fr.L: Car voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} viendra dans le feu, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chars comme l’ouragan, \q pour rendre {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère avec fureur \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} menace avec des flammes de feu.
fr.B: Voici : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vient dans le feu, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chars arrivent comme la tempête, \q pour déchaîner {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère avec fureur \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} menace en langues de feu.
fr.R: Regardez ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} arrive avec du feu ! \q Ses chars arrivent comme une tempête. \q Il va rendre à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis ce qu’ils méritent avec {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère brûlante. \q Il les punira avec des flammes de feu.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuja katika moto, \q na magari {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya vita kama kisulisuli, \q kulipa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa ghadhabu, \q na karipio {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa miali ya moto.
sw.B: Tazama! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakuja katika moto, \q na magari {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya vita yanavuma kama dhoruba, \q ili kuimimina hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa ghadhabu \q na karipio {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa ndimi za moto.
sw.R: Tazama! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakuja na moto! \q Magari {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya vita yanakuja kama dhoruba. \q Atawalipa adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inayowaka. \q Atawaadhibu kwa miali ya moto.

decisions.choice: the LORD comes in fire with chariots like the storm: God comes as a warrior to judge
decisions.reason: Fire and storm mark God's coming in 29:6; 30:27-30; Psalm 18:9-16; 50:3; and Habakkuk 3:8, where his chariots are victory. Paul uses this picture of the Lord's return in 2 Thessalonians 1:7-8.

decisions.choice: to pay back: to return his anger on the guilty, to give it full force
decisions.reason: The verb means "to cause to return". It can mean to pay back (as in verse 6) or to let anger loose; either way his enemies receive what they earned.

decisions.choice: pay back his enemies; punish them
decisions.reason: Readable names those who receive his anger ("his enemies", from verse 14) and says what his rebuke does.

source.text: כִּ֤י בָאֵשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה נִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחַרְבּ֖וֹ אֶת־כָּל־בָּשָׂ֑ר וְרַבּ֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For by fire Yahweh will enter into judgment, and by his sword, with all flesh; and many will be [the] slain of Yahweh.

en.L: For by fire {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will enter into judgment, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword, with all flesh; \q and many will be the slain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: By fire and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will bring all humanity to judgment, \q and those struck down by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be many.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will judge all people with fire and with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword. \q Many people will be killed by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Porque con fuego {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada, a toda carne; \q y muchos serán los muertos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Con fuego y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llevará a juicio a toda la humanidad, \q y serán muchos los que caigan bajo la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzgará a toda la gente con fuego y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada. \q Mucha gente morirá a manos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Car par le feu {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} entrera en jugement, \q et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée, avec toute chair ; \q et nombreuses seront les victimes {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Par le feu et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera tous les humains, \q et ceux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aura frappés seront nombreux.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera tous les gens par le feu et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée. \q Beaucoup de gens seront tués par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa moto {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atahukumu, \q na kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, wote wenye mwili; \q na waliouawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watakuwa wengi.
sw.B: Kwa moto na kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawahukumu wanadamu wote, \q na wale watakaouawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watakuwa wengi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawahukumu watu wote kwa moto na kwa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Watu wengi watauawa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: enter into judgment with all flesh: judge the whole human race
decisions.reason: "All flesh" means all humankind (40:5-6; 49:26). The same phrase comes again in verses 23 and 24, where all flesh worships God and sees the fate of the rebels.

decisions.choice: his sword, the slain of the LORD: God pictured as a warrior
decisions.reason: God's sword is a picture of his judgment (27:1; 34:5-6; Jeremiah 25:31-33).

source.text: הַמִּתְקַדְּשִׁ֨ים וְהַמִּֽטַּהֲרִ֜ים אֶל־הַגַּנּ֗וֹת אַחַ֤ר אַחַת֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ אֹֽכְלֵי֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַחֲזִ֔יר וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶץ וְהָעַכְבָּ֑ר יַחְדָּ֥ו יָסֻ֖פוּ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: The [ones] consecrating themselves and the [ones] purifying themselves to the gardens, after one in the middle, eating the flesh of the pig and the detestable thing and the mouse, together will come to an end, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Those who consecrate themselves and purify themselves [to go] to the gardens, after one in the middle, \q eating the flesh of the pig and the detestable thing and the mouse, \q together they will come to an end, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Those who set themselves apart and cleanse themselves to enter the gardens, following the one in the center, \q who eat pork, vile creatures and mice, \q will perish together, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Some people make themselves holy and clean so they can worship false gods in their gardens. They follow a leader who stands in the middle of the group. \q They eat pork, mice and other disgusting things. \q All of them will die together, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Los que se santifican y se purifican [para entrar] en los huertos, tras uno en el medio, \q que comen carne de cerdo, y la abominación, y el ratón, \q juntamente serán exterminados, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los que se consagran y se purifican para entrar en los huertos, siguiendo al que está en el centro, \q los que comen carne de cerdo, alimañas y ratones, \q perecerán juntos, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Algunos se hacen santos y puros para poder adorar a dioses falsos en sus huertos. Siguen a un líder que se pone en medio del grupo. \q Comen carne de cerdo, ratones y otras cosas repugnantes. \q Todos ellos morirán juntos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Ceux qui se consacrent et se purifient [pour aller] dans les jardins, derrière un [qui est] au milieu, \q qui mangent la chair du porc, et l’abomination, et la souris, \q ensemble ils prendront fin, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ceux qui se sanctifient et se purifient pour entrer dans les jardins, à la suite de celui qui se tient au centre, \q qui mangent du porc, des bêtes immondes et des souris, \q périront tous ensemble, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Certaines personnes se rendent saintes et pures pour adorer de faux dieux dans leurs jardins. Elles suivent un chef qui se tient au milieu du groupe. \q Elles mangent du porc, des souris et d’autres choses répugnantes. \q Toutes ces personnes mourront ensemble, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wale wanaojitakasa na kujisafisha [ili kwenda] bustanini, wakimfuata mmoja aliye katikati, \q wakila nyama ya nguruwe na chukizo na panya, \q wote pamoja watakoma, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Wale wanaojiweka wakfu na kujisafisha ili kuingia bustanini, wakimfuata yule aliye katikati, \q wanaokula nyama ya nguruwe, viumbe vya kuchukiza na panya, \q wataangamia pamoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wengine wanajifanya watakatifu na safi ili waweze kuabudu miungu ya uongo katika bustani zao. Wanamfuata kiongozi anayesimama katikati ya kundi. \q Wanakula nyama ya nguruwe, panya na vitu vingine vya kuchukiza. \q Wote watakufa pamoja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: consecrate and purify themselves for the gardens: prepare for pagan rites in sacred gardens
decisions.reason: Isaiah condemns worship in gardens in 1:29 and 65:3. The people perform rites of purification, but for the worship of other gods.

decisions.choice: after one in the middle: following a leader of the rites who stands in the center
alternatives: following a priestess in the center
behind an image in the middle
decisions.reason: The phrase is obscure. The written Hebrew text has the masculine form of "one" and the reading tradition the feminine, which could point to a priest or a priestess, or to a goddess or image set in the middle of the garden. The sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: the pig, the detestable thing and the mouse: unclean foods eaten in pagan rites
decisions.reason: The pig and the mouse were unclean (Leviticus 11:7, 29), and "detestable thing" is the word used for unclean creatures in Leviticus 11:10-13. Compare 65:4.

decisions.choice: so they can worship false gods in their gardens; a leader who stands in the middle of the group
decisions.reason: Readable says what the garden rites were and takes "one in the middle" as a leader, as Balanced does.

source.text: וְאָנֹכִ֗י מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ וּמַחְשְׁבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם בָּאָ֕ה לְקַבֵּ֥ץ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְהַלְּשֹׁנ֑וֹת וּבָ֖אוּ וְרָא֥וּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, their deeds and their thoughts, [it] is coming to gather all the nations and the tongues; and they will come and they will see my glory.

en.L: And I, their deeds and their thoughts ... [the time] is coming to gather all the nations and the tongues, and they will come and see {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory.
en.B: I, for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} part, know their deeds and their schemes. The time is coming for gathering every nation and language, and they will come and look on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory.
en.R: I know everything they do and think. The time is coming when I will gather people from every nation and every language. They will come and see {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory.

es.L: Y yo, sus obras y sus pensamientos... [el tiempo] viene de reunir a todas las naciones y lenguas, y vendrán y verán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria.
es.B: Yo, por mi parte, conozco sus obras y sus planes. Llega el tiempo de reunir a todas las naciones y lenguas, y vendrán y contemplarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria.
es.R: Yo sé todo lo que hacen y piensan. Llega el tiempo en que reuniré a gente de todas las naciones y de todos los idiomas. Vendrán y verán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria.

fr.L: Et moi, leurs œuvres et leurs pensées… [le temps] vient de rassembler toutes les nations et les langues, et elles viendront et verront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire.
fr.B: Moi, je connais leurs actes et leurs projets. Le temps vient de rassembler toutes les nations et toutes les langues ; elles viendront et contempleront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire.
fr.R: Je sais tout ce qu’ils font et tout ce qu’ils pensent. Le moment vient où je rassemblerai des gens de toutes les nations et de toutes les langues. Ils viendront et verront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire.

sw.L: Nami, matendo yao na mawazo yao ... [wakati] unakuja wa kuyakusanya mataifa yote na lugha [zote], nao watakuja na kuuona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Mimi kwa upande {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} najua matendo yao na mipango yao. Wakati unakuja wa kukusanya kila taifa na lugha, nao watakuja na kuutazama utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Najua kila kitu wanachofanya na kufikiri. Wakati unakuja ambapo nitakusanya watu kutoka kila taifa na kila lugha. Watakuja na kuuona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

decisions.choice: And I, their deeds and their thoughts: I know their deeds and thoughts
alternatives: I will punish their deeds and thoughts
because of their deeds and thoughts, I am coming
decisions.reason: The sentence has no verb. A word like "know" seems to be understood (37:28; Psalm 139:2); some ancient versions supply it. The broken sentence may show strong feeling. The sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: it is coming: the time has come for the gathering
decisions.reason: The verb is feminine with no stated subject; "the time" is a natural subject. Some read "I am coming", as in the Septuagint.

decisions.choice: all nations and tongues will come and see my glory: the nations gathered to the LORD
decisions.reason: Compare 2:2-3; 40:5; 60:3. Peoples "of every language" recall the scattering at Babel (Genesis 11:1-9), now reversed in worship (Zechariah 8:23; Revelation 7:9).

decisions.choice: know
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "know", the verb that the broken sentence seems to imply (meaning decision m1). Literal leaves the gap.

decisions.choice: I will gather
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who gathers, as the context makes plain.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י בָהֶ֜ם א֗וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י מֵהֶ֣ם׀פְּ֠לֵיטִים אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֞ם תַּרְשִׁ֨ישׁ פּ֥וּל וְל֛וּד מֹ֥שְׁכֵי קֶ֖שֶׁת תֻּבַ֣ל וְיָוָ֑ן הָאִיִּ֣ים הָרְחֹקִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־שָׁמְע֤וּ אֶת־שִׁמְעִי֙ וְלֹא־רָא֣וּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדִ֔י וְהִגִּ֥ידוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will set among them a sign, and I will send from them survivors to the nations, Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, drawers of [the] bow, Tubal and Javan, the coastlands, the distant [ones], who have not heard my report and have not seen my glory; and they will declare my glory among the nations.

en.L: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send survivors from them to the nations: Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw [the] bow, Tubal and Javan, the distant coastlands that have not heard {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fame and have not seen {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory; and they will declare {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory among the nations.
en.B: I will put a sign among them. From them I will send survivors out to the nations: to Tarshish, to Pul and to Lud, the people who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, and to the far coastlands that have not heard the news of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or seen {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory. They will tell of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory among the nations.
en.R: I will put a sign among them. I will send some of the survivors to the nations. I will send them to Tarshish, Pul and Lud, where people are skilled with bows. I will send them to Tubal and Greece, and to lands far away. The people there have never heard about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or seen {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory. The survivors will tell the nations about {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory.

es.L: Y pondré entre ellos una señal, y enviaré de ellos sobrevivientes a las naciones: a Tarsis, a Pul y a Lud, que tensan [el] arco, a Tubal y a Javán, a las costas lejanas que no han oído {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} fama ni han visto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria; y anunciarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria entre las naciones.
es.B: Pondré una señal entre ellos. De entre ellos enviaré sobrevivientes a las naciones: a Tarsis, a Pul y a Lud, pueblos que tensan el arco, a Tubal y a Javán, y a las costas lejanas que no han oído hablar de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ni han visto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria. Ellos contarán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria entre las naciones.
es.R: Pondré una señal entre ellos. Enviaré a algunos de los sobrevivientes a las naciones. Los enviaré a Tarsis, a Pul y a Lud, donde la gente es hábil con el arco. Los enviaré a Tubal y a Grecia, y a tierras lejanas. La gente de allí nunca ha oído hablar de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ni ha visto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria. Los sobrevivientes les contarán a las naciones acerca de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria.

fr.L: Et je mettrai parmi eux un signe, et j’enverrai de leurs rescapés vers les nations : Tarsis, Poul et Lud, qui tirent de l’arc, Tubal et Javan, les îles lointaines qui n’ont pas entendu parler de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} renommée et qui n’ont pas vu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire ; et ils annonceront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire parmi les nations.
fr.B: Je placerai un signe au milieu d’eux. Parmi eux, j’enverrai des rescapés vers les nations : à Tarsis, à Poul et à Lud, peuples d’archers, à Tubal et à Javan, et aux îles lointaines qui n’ont jamais entendu parler de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ni vu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire. Ils raconteront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire parmi les nations.
fr.R: Je mettrai un signe au milieu d’eux. J’enverrai certains des survivants vers les nations. Je les enverrai à Tarsis, à Poul et à Lud, où les gens sont habiles à tirer à l’arc. Je les enverrai à Tubal et en Grèce, et dans des pays lointains. Les gens de là-bas n’ont jamais entendu parler de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et n’ont jamais vu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire. Les survivants annonceront {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire aux nations.
