sw.L: Nami nitaweka ishara kati yao, nami nitawatuma waliookoka kutoka kwao kwa mataifa: Tarshishi, Pulu, na Ludi, wavutao upinde, Tubali na Yavani, visiwa vilivyo mbali ambavyo havijasikia sifa {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala havijaona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; nao watatangaza utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kati ya mataifa.
sw.B: Nitaweka ishara kati yao. Kutoka kwao nitawatuma walionusurika waende kwa mataifa: Tarshishi, Pulu na Ludi, watu wanaovuta upinde, Tubali na Yavani, na pwani za mbali ambazo hazijasikia habari {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala kuona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Watatangaza utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kati ya mataifa.
sw.R: Nitaweka ishara kati yao. Nitawatuma baadhi ya walionusurika kwa mataifa. Nitawatuma Tarshishi, Pulu na Ludi, mahali ambapo watu ni hodari wa kutumia upinde. Nitawatuma Tubali na Ugiriki, na kwa nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari. Watu wa huko hawajawahi kusikia habari {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala kuona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Walionusurika watawaambia mataifa habari za utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

decisions.choice: a sign: a mark of God's act that the nations will see, not further described
decisions.reason: The sign is not explained. It may be the judgment and deliverance of verses 15-18, or the survivors themselves, sent out as witnesses (8:18; 11:10-12). The sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan: peoples at the far edges of the known world
decisions.reason: Tarshish lay far to the west by sea (23:1-14; Jonah 1:3). Lud and Put (a people of Africa) appear together as soldiers in Jeremiah 46:9 and Ezekiel 27:10; 30:5. Tubal was in Asia Minor (Ezekiel 27:13), and Javan is Greece and the Greek coastlands (Genesis 10:2-4). The places stand for the whole world, west and north.

decisions.choice: Pul: the Hebrew name is kept
decisions.reason: "Pul" is not known as a nation elsewhere. The Septuagint reads "Put", the African people named with Lud in Jeremiah 46:9, and it may read "Meshech", a people paired with Tubal (Ezekiel 27:13; 38:2), where the Hebrew has "who draw the bow". The Hebrew is followed here.

decisions.choice: Greece; lands far away
decisions.reason: Readable gives the modern name for Javan, and says "lands far away" for the coastlands, as elsewhere in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: Tarsis, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javán (L, B); Grecia for Javán (R)
decisions.reason: The names follow the Hebrew text ("Pul"), in the forms of the published Genesis 10; Readable gives "Grecia" for Javán, as the English Readable says "Greece".

decisions.choice: Tarshishi, Pulu, Ludi, Tubali, Yavani (Literal, Balanced); Ugiriki for Yavani (Readable)
decisions.reason: The far peoples (meaning decision m2) keep their Hebrew names in Swahili spelling; Readable gives Javan as Greece, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Tarsis, Poul, Lud, Tubal, Javan" (L, B); "Grèce" for Javan (R)
decisions.reason: The names keep the French forms of 1 Chronicles 1 and 1 Kings 10:22; Readable gives the modern name for Javan, as the English does.

source.text: וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֶת־כָּל־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם מִכָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֣ם׀מִנְחָ֣ה׀לַֽיהוָ֡ה בַּסּוּסִ֡ים וּ֠בָרֶכֶב וּבַצַּבִּ֨ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֜ים וּבַכִּרְכָּר֗וֹת עַ֣ל הַ֥ר קָדְשִׁ֛י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבִיאוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֛ה בִּכְלִ֥י טָה֖וֹר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations [as] an offering to Yahweh, on horses and in chariot[s] and in litters and on mules and on camels, to [the] mountain of my holiness, Jerusalem, says Yahweh, just as the sons of Israel bring the offering in a clean vessel [to the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And they will bring all {{gender:your brothers and sisters|your brothers}} from all the nations [as] an offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, on horses and in chariots and in litters and on mules and on camels, to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, Jerusalem, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel bring the offering in a clean vessel [to] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They will bring all your kin out of every nation as an offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They will come on horses, in chariots and covered carts, on mules and on swift camels, to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, Jerusalem, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} bring grain offerings to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in clean vessels.
en.R: They will bring all your fellow Israelites back from all the nations. They will bring them as an offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They will ride on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels. They will come to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain in Jerusalem, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It will be like when the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} bring grain offerings to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in clean dishes.

es.L: Y traerán a todos {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}} de todas las naciones [como] ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, en caballos y en carros y en literas y en mulos y en camellos, a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte, Jerusalén, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, así como los hijos de Israel traen la ofrenda en vasija limpia [a] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Traerán a todos {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}} de entre todas las naciones como ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Vendrán a caballo, en carros y en carretas cubiertas, en mulas y en camellos veloces, a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte, Jerusalén, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, como los israelitas traen ofrendas de grano a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en vasijas limpias.
es.R: Traerán de vuelta de todas las naciones a todos {{plural_you:sus compatriotas israelitas|vuestros compatriotas israelitas}}. Los traerán como ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Vendrán a caballo, en carros y en carretas, y en mulas y camellos. Llegarán a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte en Jerusalén, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Será como cuando los israelitas traen ofrendas de grano al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en recipientes limpios.

fr.L: Et ils amèneront tous {{gender:vos frères et sœurs|vos frères}} de toutes les nations [en] offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, sur des chevaux, et dans des chars, et dans des litières, et sur des mulets, et sur des dromadaires, à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, Jérusalem, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël apportent l’offrande dans un vase pur [à] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils ramèneront de toutes les nations tous vos proches en offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Ils viendront à cheval, en char et en voiture couverte, à dos de mulet et de dromadaire, jusqu’à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, Jérusalem, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} apportent leurs offrandes végétales à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans des vases purs.
fr.R: Ils ramèneront de toutes les nations tous vos compatriotes israélites. Ils les apporteront en offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Ils viendront à cheval, en char et en chariot, à dos de mulet et de chameau. Ils arriveront à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, à Jérusalem, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ce sera comme quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} apportent leurs offrandes de céréales au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans des plats purs.

sw.L: Nao watawaleta ndugu zenu wote kutoka mataifa yote [kuwa] sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, juu ya farasi na katika magari ya vita na katika machela na juu ya nyumbu na juu ya ngamia, mpaka mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, Yerusalemu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama vile wana wa Israeli wanavyoleta sadaka katika chombo safi [kwenye] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watawaleta ndugu zenu wote kutoka kila taifa kuwa sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watakuja juu ya farasi, katika magari ya vita na magari yaliyofunikwa, juu ya nyumbu na juu ya ngamia wepesi, mpaka mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, Yerusalemu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama Waisraeli wanavyoleta sadaka za nafaka katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndani ya vyombo safi.
sw.R: Watawarudisha Waisraeli wenzenu wote kutoka mataifa yote. Watawaleta kuwa sadaka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watapanda farasi, magari ya vita na mikokoteni, nyumbu na ngamia. Watakuja kwenye mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu huko Yerusalemu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Itakuwa kama Waisraeli wanapoleta sadaka za nafaka kwenye hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndani ya vyombo safi.

decisions.choice: your brothers: fellow Israelites scattered among the nations
decisions.reason: The survivors from the nations (verse 19) bring back the scattered people of Israel (11:12; 43:5-7; 49:22; 60:4, 9).

decisions.choice: as an offering in a clean vessel: the returning exiles are presented to God like a holy gift
decisions.reason: The nations bring Israel's scattered people to God as worshipers bring a grain offering in a ritually clean vessel. Paul speaks of his work among the Gentiles in the language of this verse (Romans 15:16).

decisions.choice: litters, camels: covered carts or carrying chairs; swift camels
decisions.reason: The first word is used of covered wagons in Numbers 7:3. The last word occurs only here; it seems to mean fast-running camels or dromedaries.

decisions.choice: your fellow Israelites; the temple of the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says who "your brothers" are (meaning decision m1) and calls the house of the LORD the temple.

decisions.choice: Waisraeli, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "Israelites / sons of Israel" under the gender setting. Swahili "Waisraeli" and Literal's "wana wa Israeli" both include women, so Balanced and Readable say "Waisraeli" without a span.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Israël" (L), "{{gender:Israélites|fils d'Israël}}" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Israel take the gender spans settled for the Pentateuch, matching the English spans in this verse.

source.text: וְגַם־מֵהֶ֥ם אֶקַּ֛ח לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים לַלְוִיִּ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And also from them I will take for priests, for Levites, says Yahweh.

en.L: And also from them I will take [some] for priests [and] for Levites, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: And I will even take some of them to be priests and Levites, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will even choose some of them to serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests and Levites, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y también de ellos tomaré [algunos] para sacerdotes [y] para levitas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Y aun tomaré a algunos de ellos para que sean sacerdotes y levitas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Incluso escogeré a algunos de ellos para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirvan como sacerdotes y levitas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et parmi eux aussi j’en prendrai pour prêtres [et] pour Lévites, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Et j’en prendrai même parmi eux pour être prêtres et Lévites, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je choisirai même certains d’entre eux pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servir comme prêtres et comme Lévites, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na pia kutoka kwao nitachukua [baadhi] kuwa makuhani [na] Walawi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hata nitawachukua baadhi yao kuwa makuhani na Walawi, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitawachagua hata baadhi yao wanitumikie kama makuhani na Walawi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: some of them: perhaps from the nations who bring the exiles, perhaps from the exiles themselves
decisions.reason: "Them" may be the people of the nations (verses 18-19) or the scattered Israelites they bring home (verse 20). If it is the nations, God will even make foreigners his priests (56:6-7; 61:6). The word "also" suggests something surprising, but the sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: priests and Levites: those who served at the altar and in the temple
decisions.reason: Under the law only descendants of Aaron could be priests, and the other Levites served beside them (Numbers 3:5-10; 18:1-7).

decisions.choice: to serve me
decisions.reason: Readable says what priests and Levites do.

source.text: כִּ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם הַ֠חֳדָשִׁים וְהָאָ֨רֶץ הַחֲדָשָׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה עֹמְדִ֥ים לְפָנַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה כֵּ֛ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד זַרְעֲכֶ֖ם וְשִׁמְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For just as the heavens, the new [ones], and the earth, the new [one], which I [am] making, [are] standing before me, declares Yahweh, so will stand your offspring and your name.

en.L: For just as the new heavens and the new earth that I [am] making will endure before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q so your offspring and your name will endure.
en.B: The new heavens and the new earth that I am about to make will stand firm in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q in the same way your descendants and your name will stand firm.
en.R: I am going to make a new heaven and a new earth, and they will last in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q In the same way, your descendants and your name will last too.

es.L: Porque así como los cielos nuevos y la tierra nueva que yo hago permanecerán delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q así permanecerán {{plural_you:su descendencia y su nombre|vuestra descendencia y vuestro nombre}}.
es.B: Los cielos nuevos y la tierra nueva que voy a hacer permanecerán firmes en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q de la misma manera permanecerán firmes {{plural_you:sus descendientes y su nombre|vuestros descendientes y vuestro nombre}}.
es.R: Voy a hacer un cielo nuevo y una tierra nueva, y durarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q De la misma manera, {{plural_you:sus descendientes y su nombre|vuestros descendientes y vuestro nombre}} también durarán.

fr.L: Car de même que les nouveaux cieux et la nouvelle terre que je fais subsisteront devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q ainsi subsisteront votre descendance et votre nom.
fr.B: Les nouveaux cieux et la nouvelle terre que je vais faire tiendront ferme devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q de même, votre descendance et votre nom tiendront ferme.
fr.R: Je vais faire un nouveau ciel et une nouvelle terre, et ils dureront devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q De la même manière, vos descendants et votre nom dureront aussi.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile mbingu mpya na nchi mpya ninazozifanya zitadumu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ndivyo uzao wenu na jina lenu vitakavyodumu.
sw.B: Mbingu mpya na nchi mpya ninazokaribia kuzifanya zitasimama imara mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q vivyo hivyo wazao wenu na jina lenu vitasimama imara.
sw.R: Nitafanya mbingu mpya na nchi mpya, nazo zitadumu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Vivyo hivyo, wazao wenu na jina lenu vitadumu pia.

decisions.choice: the new heavens and the new earth: the renewed creation promised in 65:17
decisions.reason: The promise of 65:17 returns here. Peter and John take it up (2 Peter 3:13; Revelation 21:1).

decisions.choice: endure: last and remain, as God's new creation will
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for both: as the new creation stands before God, so will Israel's descendants and name. Compare 48:19 and 56:5, where a lasting name is promised.

source.text: וְהָיָ֗ה מִֽדֵּי־חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בְּחָדְשׁ֔וֹ וּמִדֵּ֥י שַׁבָּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ יָב֧וֹא כָל־בָּשָׂ֛ר לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֥ת לְפָנַ֖י אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be [that] from new moon in its new moon, and from sabbath in its sabbath, all flesh will come to bow down before me, says Yahweh.

en.L: And it will be [that] from new moon to new moon \q and from Sabbath to Sabbath, \q all flesh will come to bow down before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Month after month at the new moon, \q and week after week on the Sabbath, \q all humanity will come to bow in worship before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: At every new moon festival and on every Sabbath day, \q all people will come to worship {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] de luna nueva en luna nueva \q y de sábado en sábado, \q toda carne vendrá a postrarse delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Mes tras mes, en la luna nueva, \q y semana tras semana, en el sábado, \q toda la humanidad vendrá a postrarse en adoración delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: En cada fiesta de luna nueva y en cada día de sábado, \q toda la gente vendrá a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para adorar, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il arrivera que, de nouvelle lune en nouvelle lune \q et de sabbat en sabbat, \q toute chair viendra se prosterner devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: De mois en mois, à chaque nouvelle lune, \q et de semaine en semaine, à chaque sabbat, \q tous les humains viendront se prosterner devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: À chaque fête de la nouvelle lune et à chaque sabbat, \q tous les gens viendront {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}adorer, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] tangu mwezi mpya hata mwezi mpya, \q na tangu Sabato hata Sabato, \q wote wenye mwili watakuja kusujudu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mwezi baada ya mwezi wakati wa mwezi mpya, \q na wiki baada ya wiki siku ya Sabato, \q wanadamu wote watakuja kuinama na kuabudu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kila sikukuu ya mwezi mpya na kila siku ya Sabato, \q watu wote watakuja kuniabudu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: new moon and Sabbath: the regular monthly and weekly days of worship
decisions.reason: The new moon began each month with offerings (Numbers 28:11-15), and the Sabbath was the weekly day of rest. The same feasts were condemned when kept without obedience (1:13-14); now they are kept by all peoples.

decisions.choice: all flesh will come to bow down: all peoples worship the LORD
decisions.reason: In verse 16 "all flesh" faces God's judgment; here all flesh comes to worship him (45:23; Psalm 65:3; Zechariah 14:16).

source.text: וְיָצְא֣וּ וְרָא֔וּ בְּפִגְרֵי֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַפֹּשְׁעִ֖ים בִּ֑י כִּ֣י תוֹלַעְתָּ֞ם לֹ֣א תָמ֗וּת וְאִשָּׁם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ דֵרָא֖וֹן לְכָל־בָּשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will go out and they will look on [the] corpses of the men, the [ones] rebelling against me; for their worm will not die, and their fire will not be quenched, and they will be an abhorrence to all flesh.

en.L: And they will go out and look on the corpses of the men who rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q for their worm will not die and their fire will not be quenched, \q and they will be an abhorrence to all flesh.
en.B: Then they will go out and gaze on the corpses of the people who rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q For their worm will not die, nor will their fire be put out, \q and they will be a horror to every living being.
en.R: Then the worshipers will go out and see the dead bodies of those who turned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q The worms in those bodies will never die. The fire that burns them will never go out. \q Everyone who sees them will be disgusted.

es.L: Y saldrán y mirarán los cadáveres de los hombres que se rebelaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, \q porque su gusano no morirá y su fuego no se apagará, \q y serán abominación para toda carne.
es.B: Entonces saldrán y contemplarán los cadáveres de los que se rebelaron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Porque su gusano no morirá, ni su fuego se apagará, \q y serán un horror para todo ser viviente.
es.R: Entonces los que adoran saldrán y verán los cadáveres de los que se volvieron contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Los gusanos de esos cuerpos nunca morirán. El fuego que los quema nunca se apagará. \q Todos los que los vean sentirán asco.

fr.L: Et ils sortiront et regarderont les cadavres des hommes qui se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q car leur ver ne mourra pas et leur feu ne s’éteindra pas, \q et ils seront un objet d’horreur pour toute chair.
fr.B: Alors ils sortiront et regarderont les cadavres des gens qui se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Car leur ver ne mourra pas, et leur feu ne s’éteindra pas, \q et ils seront un objet d’horreur pour tout être vivant.
fr.R: Alors ceux qui sont venus adorer sortiront et verront les corps morts de ceux qui se sont révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Les vers dans ces corps ne mourront jamais. Le feu qui les brûle ne s’éteindra jamais. \q Tous ceux qui les verront seront dégoûtés.

sw.L: Nao watatoka na kuitazama mizoga ya watu walioniasi, \q kwa maana funza wao hawatakufa, wala moto wao hautazimwa, \q nao watakuwa chukizo kwa wote wenye mwili.
sw.B: Kisha watatoka na kuikodolea macho maiti za watu walioniasi. \q Kwa maana funza wao hawatakufa, wala moto wao hautazimwa, \q nao watakuwa kitu cha kutisha kwa kila mwenye uhai.
sw.R: Kisha waabudu watatoka na kuona maiti za watu walioniasi. \q Funza walio katika maiti hizo hawatakufa kamwe. Moto unaoziteketeza hautazimika kamwe. \q Kila mtu atakayeziona atachukizwa.

decisions.choice: their worm will not die and their fire will not be quenched: the endless end of the rebels
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes these words in Mark 9:48 of Gehenna, the valley outside Jerusalem whose name came to stand for final judgment. The word for "abhorrence" occurs elsewhere only in Daniel 12:2, of those who rise "to everlasting contempt".

decisions.choice: they will go out and look: those who come to worship (verse 23) see the fate of the rebels
decisions.reason: The worshipers leave Jerusalem and see the bodies of the rebels outside the city. When this chapter is read in the synagogue, verse 23 is read again after verse 24 so that the book ends on worship, not on judgment. The text itself is not changed.

decisions.choice: the worshipers
decisions.reason: Readable names those who go out: the people of all nations who come to worship in verse 23.

decisions.choice: The worms in those bodies will never die; Everyone who sees them will be disgusted
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the worm and the abhorrence are.

decisions.choice: su gusano no morirá y su fuego no se apagará
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes these words in Mark 9:48; Spanish keeps the key words ("gusano", "no morirá", "fuego", "no se apagará") so the quotation can be recognized.

decisions.choice: funza wao hawatakufa, wala moto wao hautazimwa
decisions.reason: Jesus takes up the line in Mark 9:48, where the published Swahili has "funza ... hawafi kamwe, na moto hauzimwi kamwe"; the same words, funza and moto, are kept.

decisions.choice: "leur ver ne mourra pas et leur feu ne s'éteindra pas"
decisions.reason: Mark 9:48 takes up this line ("leur ver ne meurt pas et le feu ne s'éteint pas" in the published French); French keeps the same verbs so the link can be seen.
